CARTELS : Giving form to absences, embodying narratives, situating knowledge

October 2026

What does the museum show, and what remains out of sight? This carefully put-together, temporary installation of museum labels (‘cartels’ in French) brings together around fifteen texts written by authors with diverse backgrounds including activism, art, research or museum outreach. The installation highlights the tensions and dissonances between the museum presentation, the silences and absences it perpetuates, and the infinite voices that exist outside institutional discourse.
